newsitem.title: USA: Sun Micro to buy Thinking Machines assets.
newsitem.headline: Sun Micro to buy Thinking Machines assets.

text.p: Sun Microsystems Inc on Tuesday said it reached an agreement to purchase the GlobalWorks-related assets of Thinking Machines Corp., a pioneer in high-performance parallel computing, for an undisclosed amount.

In a statement, Sun said the purchase of Thinking Machines' GlobalWorks software will strengthen Sun's technology platform to meet the requirements of high-performance computing in markets including financial analysis, research and development, mechanical engineering analysis, electronic design and geoscience.
As part of the agreement, Sun will offer employment to all employees associated with the GlobalWorks business unit of Thinking Machines.
